readme: Same frame as the 72 Snack Collection model: Current State (what sells today), plus Retailer Expansion and SKU Expansion as incremental tabs, rolling to Overall. Retail $ at shelf.

Whole Foods, global. 7 Exotic bars, 3 oz, in the deli set: Raw Honey Cacao, Black Salt Caramel, Pink Salt Caramel, Matcha, Banana Coconut, Mo's Bacon, Turmeric Ginger. Confirmed on wholefoodsmarket.com and Amazon/Whole Foods 2026-11-07.

The WS27 pouch into the launch plan tiers. Whole Foods expands first: 3 SKUs in Mar-27, the other 2 in Jun-27. Sprouts, the UNFI unlocks and the KeHE unlocks start once the full set exists (Jun-27). Hold stays at zero. Expected doors = doors x tier hit rate. Launch month = later of the tier gate and review month + pitch offset + ship lag.
Wave 2 (Peanut Butter Bonbons, Hazelnut Praline, Toffee Bites) and the shelf-stable truffle pouch, stairstepped into the Tier 1 pouch doors that exist when each is ready.
Every number is a link or a sum. Also backs out 40 retailer / 15 distributor to brand revenue and checks it against the intake FDM number.
Blank Pack Love in-store templates for the Whole Foods program, built against the recommended Trade + Marketing.
Blue = input. Gold fill = a guess to replace with real data. Black = formula. Green = pulled from another tab.
Bar and pouch velocity (no SPINS yet), Whole Foods door count, tier hit rates and spend %, Sprouts door count, WS27 timing. Swap in SPINS or the Whole Foods vendor report and the whole model moves.
Pouch cannibalizing bars at Whole Foods; Amazon/DTC/corporate gifting; Faire independents; private label cups (separate lane, see the Private Label grid).

retailer_expansion.sub: Launch mo: Whole Foods pouch = the first drop (an expansion of an existing account, no review wait); everyone else = MAX(tier gate, review mo + pitch offset + ship lag, full-set month). Whole Foods takes 3 pouch SKUs at the first drop and 2 more at the second; every other account starts once the full set exists. Expected doors = doors x tier hit rate. Revenue = expected doors x SKUs x fit x rate / 12 x ramp. Launch past month 12 = 2028.

dashboard.footer_note: Calendar 2027, Jan to Dec, same frame as 72. Revenue tile is retail $ at shelf. Spend % and the P&L run on gross sales (after 40 retailer / 15 distributor): gross sales, less trade = net sales, less COGS (margin calculator ceilings: bar 2.85, pouch 2.56) = gross profit, less marketing = contribution margin, before overhead. Existing business is Whole Foods: 7 Exotic bars, 3 oz, deli set, 400 doors assumed (75 percent of about 530 US doors; bars confirmed on wholefoodsmarket.com in Chicago and SoCal 2026-11-07, authorized count from Andy pending). Retailer Expansion: Whole Foods takes 3 pouch SKUs in Mar-27 and 2 more in Jun-27; Sprouts, UNFI and KeHE accounts start Jun-27 with the full set, at tier hit rates (Whole Foods and Sprouts 75%); Hold at zero. SKU Expansion stairsteps wave 2 into the Tier 1 pouch doors. Gold cells are the guesses: velocity (bars 1.5, launch pouches 3.0, wave 2 pouches 2.0 u/s/w; no SPINS yet), Whole Foods door count, Sprouts doors, tier hit rates and spend %, WS27 timing. Pouch cannibalization of bars is not modeled. Download the workbook for formulas and the Whole Foods Plan / Vol templates.

Velocity is a 1.5 u/s/w placeholder: that puts Whole Foods bars at about {sanity_pct}% of the 2.7M FDM brand number from intake. Calibrate to the vendor portal or SPINS.

retailer_card.label: Retailer Expansion: WS27 pouch (prospective, incremental)
retailer_card.note: Whole Foods expands first: 3 pouch SKUs in Mar-27 (in development, maybe sooner), the other 2 in Jun-27, at 75% odds. Pouch velocity 3.0 u/s/w, above the bars: higher perceived value and multiple usage occasions. Every other account waits for the full set and starts Jun-27: Sprouts, the UNFI unlocks (Fresh Market, Natural Grocers, Plum, Bristol Farms, PCC, Heinen's, Market of Choice) and the KeHE unlocks if Sprouts lands (Gelson's, Central Market, Lassen's, Erewhon halo, Fresh Thyme watch). Wegmans takes 3 bars from Jul-27, not the pouch. Kroger, H-E-B, Woodman's, Jewel-Osco, Mariano's sit in Hold at zero: private label conversation only.

sku_card.label: SKU / TDP Expansion: wave 2 (prospective, incremental)
sku_card.note: Starts two months after the second pouch drop, one every 2 months, at 2.0 u/s/w into the Whole Foods and Sprouts pouch doors: Peanut Butter Bonbons Aug-27, Hazelnut Praline Oct-27, Toffee Bites Dec-27. The truffle pouch and Espresso fall into 2028. Not modeled: refrigerated, grocery gifting boxes, bark, branded PB cups (cups are private label).
